verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Terminal accepting natural-language commands itself, such as a built-in assistant or conversational interface for running readers or payments. The Stripe MCP server (stripe-terminal-docs-35) gives external AI agents tools to call the Stripe API, but that is a building block for another product's agent and belongs to the MCP-server story, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
